title: Grilled Shrimp Skewers with Australian BBQ Sauce
description: A delicious keto recipe featuring grilled shrimp skewers smothered in a sweet and tangy Australian BBQ sauce.
instructions: Thread shrimp onto the yellow skewers, leaving a little space between each shrimp.
Brush the shrimp with a little bit of Australian BBQ sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the shrimp for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the shrimp is cooking, warm up the remaining Australian BBQ sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
Once the shrimp is cooked, brush with the warmed BBQ sauce and serve immediately.
Drizzle with a little bit of gooey honey for extra sweetness.
